evidenceVerification.nativePageAdapterCheck: 18 official package files and 4 Slate runtime files independently verified unchanged by the full backend check.
evidenceVerification.disposableDatabaseShutdown: Reported checked by the implementer after both final runs; the reviewer did not independently rerun PostgreSQL or recheck its process lifecycle.

staticReview.isolation: Requires explicit test opt-in, an approved loopback PostgreSQL URL/name, matching current_database(), test-mode loaded Strapi, local upload provider and loopback HTTP server. Uses the existing owned disposable CMS fixture roles.
staticReview.ownership: Randomly prefixed rows and an exact provider-path ownership set are the only upload data removed. Preexisting rows, file hashes, settings/configuration and permission rows/IDs are compared after restoration.
staticReview.admissionAndDrain: Owned single-use request tickets enter AsyncLocalStorage at Koa.handleRequest. Admission is closed before cleanup; pending promises are repeatedly drained across setImmediate until the generation remains stable and empty. The request fence remains until outer server close.
staticReview.semantics: Instrumentation preserves the native call receiver, arguments and original returned value/promise; synchronous throws propagate. Original service descriptors are restored. Unowned calls retain their native behavior.
staticReview.unexpectedErrors: Marked detached event failures are retained separately from expected fail-fast request/provider failures. They are asserted absent only after draining, cleanup and restoration, so an unexpected detached rejection cannot silently qualify a successful run.
staticReview.imageChecks: Independent zlib PNG fixtures define complete expected RGBA pixels. Actual upload-resolved sharp and native image-manipulation APIs validate originals, thumbnails and responsive variants, optimization, stream metadata/validation, safe SVG and malformed/truncated inputs.
staticReview.unchangedScope: No backend production application/configuration, native Page/Slate adapter, workflow, audit gate or runner was changed. The existing CMS integration helper only adds the bounded upload test invocation.

nativeHttpCoverage: Anonymous, B2B and denied-role identities rejected without row/file writes.
Real PNG multipart upload persists and serves original plus thumbnail/large/medium/small variants, each fully decoded.
Safe SVG multipart upload serves exact bytes and full decoded pixels without raster variants.
Malformed raster request rejects without persisted row/provider bytes.
Admitted client abort occurs while the native provider is held; real provider/row completion precedes teardown.

Injected fail-fast multipart sibling returns HTTP 500 while another native provider remains pending; the late branch then passes separately gated native metrics and FILE create stages and persists its real row before drain finishes.
syntheticCoverageSeparateFromHttp: Fail-fast promise sibling and newly started descendant
Detached event rejection retention through restoration

resolvedReviewFindings.finding: A fail-fast branch could leave native file-service awaits outside the tracked seams.
resolvedReviewFindings.resolution: All callable file-service methods are now tracked in the owned scope.

resolvedReviewFindings.finding: Native upload/remove emits an asynchronous event without awaiting its returned promise.
resolvedReviewFindings.resolution: Owned eventHub.emit is tracked; separate unawaited event/cleanup-descendant control passes.

resolvedReviewFindings.finding: Detached event rejections could be consumed by allSettled without failing qualification.
resolvedReviewFindings.resolution: Marked detached errors are recorded and asserted after restoration; the rejection/restoration control passes.

resolvedReviewFindings.finding: The ownership provider wrapper dropped additional call arguments.
resolvedReviewFindings.resolution: Unhooked and unowned calls now forward the full arguments with Reflect.apply.

openQualificationLimits: The mandatory full npm audit failed with exit 1: 29 high and 3 moderate affected packages. No sharp finding is present. This review supplies no waiver, relaxed gate or production-only substitute.
Native PostgreSQL qualification used local 17.11 rather than the CI PostgreSQL 16 environment.
No browser was attempted, no hosted exact-head CI was established, and no merge/deploy/release authorization is implied.
Native HTTP counts are six new cases within 110 passing integration tests; 15 focused tests and 662 backend checks are fresh counts, not historical 743/109/45 parity.

The reviewer independently repeated the focused and complete backend checks. Native HTTP, Page HTTP and admin-build outcomes were independently inspected and hash-verified from the implementer logs rather than re-executed by this reviewer.

Controlled failure hooks deliberately retain the late fixture stream after native temp cleanup and delay metrics/FILE persistence. These demonstrate real HTTP/native provider/database completion under controlled failure, not an exploit reproducer.

Late-admission and detached-error scenarios use synthetic collaborators. No hard process-kill/crash recovery, arbitrary future unreturned background-task guarantee, or general malware/upload-security assessment is claimed.
